description.value: Kicking Horse Café is the flagship physical café of Kicking Horse Coffee Co. Ltd., a Canadian Rocky Mountain specialty roaster that has been sourcing 100% organic and Fairtrade coffee for over 25 years. Located in Invermere in the Columbia Valley, it serves espresso drinks and food in a space that customer reviews call gorgeous, with an ethos of lingering and community. For cyclists passing through the Kootenays, it offers a chance to experience a well-loved BC coffee brand at its source.

Ltd., with customer reviews and a dedicated café page showing coffee drinks and food offerings. OSM has no address or phone, so those fields are sourced from the website's contact page.
